records.context: This has two consequences. A bystander phenotype cannot be detected, because no column separates a bystander from a distant uninfected cell. records.context: SQLite's ``PRAGMA user_version`` is the on-disk schema version.  Migrations are registered here as a contiguous, ordered sequence and are applied in one transaction. A database created by an older spaCR release therefore follows the same path whether it is opened for reading or for writing, while a database created by a newer release is rejected before any mutation.
records.translation: SQLite 的 ``PRAGMA user_version`` 是磁盘上的模式版本。迁移在这里注册为一个连续、有序的序列，并在一个事务中应用。因此，由旧版 spaCR 创建的数据库无论是为读取还是写入而打开，都遵循同一条路径，而由更新版本创建的数据库会在任何修改之前被拒绝。
